cover.title: When the desktop app is still the right tool
cover.overview: Run three desktop-only moves on kitepump.ditamap that you would not bet a browser tab on.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled mock if the app cannot open.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Desktop still wins some jobs
blocks.body:
The booklet view. A completeness check. A transformation log. A rename that updates pointers. Work with no internet.

A person who only needs to read one page on a train does not need those buttons. Do not make them install the desktop app for a comment.

You are the person with the booklet. You still need the desktop.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Desktop app** :  Oxygen installed on your computer. Full menus. Files on disk. The desk you have used since week 1.

cards.back: Oxygen installed on your computer. Full menus. Files on disk. The desk you have used since week 1

blocks.title: DITA Maps Manager View in Oxygen XML Editor 19
watchFor: Where you run a completeness check from the booklet

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You skip the completeness check, or you write slogans about ‘the cloud’ with no file in your hand.

Expected: Completeness ran. Three desktop moves named with evidence.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Open kitepump.ditamap in Maps Manager. Run Validate and Check for Completeness. Write the result (clean, or the first row you saw).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Open Configure Transformation Scenario. Write the scenario name you would run. Do not hunt for that same local publish inside a browser tab.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Turn off wifi for a minute, or write how you would open the booklet on a train with no signal. The desktop copy on disk still opens. A browser tab may not.

blocks.summary: Completeness ran. Three desktop moves named with evidence.

blocks.q: A completeness check on the booklet is mainly a desktop job this course. True or not?
options: True :  you ran it in Maps Manager last month, and you run it here again
Not true :  only a browser tab can check links
Not true :  Help > About checks the booklet
blocks.why: Maps Manager lives on the desktop app. A reviewer in a browser does not need this button.

blocks.q: Last week you published WebHelp to a folder on your computer. Who needs that job?
options: Every reviewer who only comments on one sentence
The person who owns the booklet and the publish log
Nobody :  publish logs are optional forever
blocks.why: A browser editor may preview a page. The transform log you debug lives on the desktop (or on a publish server). Not on a reviewer’s phone.
